name: linuxdo-friends
description: 佬朋友 - LinuxDo Friends browser extension

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --config vite.cloud-save.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --config vite.cloud-save.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:chrome && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --watch
